AMUT.Settings.UseHandbook.Name: Use Mutant's Handbook rules
AMUT.Settings.UseHandbook.Hint: Replace the system's Corruption → mutation flow with The Mutant's Handbook rules: species type roll, TB/WPB Corruption loss, severity roll, compendium tables, GM-confirmed result card with a Resilience opt-out. Turn off for stock system behaviour.
AMUT.Settings.KeepingItRandom.Name: Optional rule: Keeping it Random
AMUT.Settings.KeepingItRandom.Hint: Handbook p9. Roll severity on a plain 1d100 with no bonus for existing mutations: 1-33 Trivial, 34-66 Minor, 67-99 Major, 100 Chosen of Chaos.
AMUT.Settings.LetThemOff.Name: Optional rule: Let them off with a warning!
AMUT.Settings.LetThemOff.Hint: Handbook p9. A character's first physical mutation is Trivial instead of rolling severity.
AMUT.Settings.PromptSource.Name: Ask for the mutation source
AMUT.Settings.PromptSource.Hint: After the severity roll, ask whether to roll on the normal, Necromantic (module homebrew) or a Chaos God table. When off, the normal tables are used. Chosen of Chaos always use their patron's table.
AMUT.Settings.SpeciesFallback.Name: Species fallback
AMUT.Settings.SpeciesFallback.Hint: The handbook species table (p8) only lists Dwarf, Elf, Halfling, Human, Gnome and Ogre. Other species roll as this one.
AMUT.Step.LetThemOff: first physical mutation (Let them off with a warning!)
AMUT.Card.Title: Dissolution of Body and Mind
AMUT.Card.ChosenText: The character is Chosen by a Chaos God (p9). The GM picks the patron; from now on every mutation comes from the patron's table (p74). Picking a god also rolls this mutation on that table.
AMUT.Status.resistedBy: {name} spent 1 Resilience ({from} → {to}) to avoid the mutation. Corruption is still lost (p9).
AMUT.Note.ChooseOne: This result offers a choice: the GM adds one of the mutations below.
AMUT.Note.ManualSubtable: This mutation picks between several sub-tables; roll them by hand.
AMUT.Note.NurgleMisprint: Nurgle footnote ** on Corrupted Blood is a misprint (it lists skin types); the GM decides (p75).
AMUT.Note.FootnoteMiss: God footnote result "{name}" not found in the sub-table; rolled the full table instead.
AMUT.Spawn.Title: Chaos Spawn
AMUT.Spawn.Warning: {name} has more mutations than they can bear and becomes a mindless Chaos Spawn.
AMUT.Warn.NoActor: Mutant's Handbook: no actor found. Select a token or use the Generate Mutation macro.
AMUT.Warn.NoActors: Mutant's Handbook: you don't own any actors.
AMUT.Warn.NoTable: Table "{column}" not found in the module compendium.
AMUT.Warn.Missing: Mutation "{name}" not found in the module compendium.
AMUT.Warn.NoGM: A GM must be logged in to spend Resilience on this card.
AMUT.Warn.Rerolled: The Dissolution test for {name} was rerolled or had SL added. The mutation card from the first roll stands; if the test now passes, discard that card (Corruption already lost must be restored by hand).
AMUT.Settings.AutoGrants.Name: Add the Talents, Traits, items and rolled modifiers a mutation grants
AMUT.Settings.AutoGrants.Hint: When a handbook mutation is added to an actor, also add the Talents, Creature Traits, Psychology, Skill advances, natural armour and linked mutations its text grants, asking for choices and rolling the in-text sub-tables, and roll or ask for its variable Characteristic, Movement and Wounds modifiers (1d10 rolls, hit locations, body parts, size steps). Deleting the mutation removes them again. Fixed modifiers are ordinary effects on the item and apply either way.
AMUT.Grant.Title: {name}: granted items
AMUT.Grant.Failed: {name}: adding the granted items failed ({error}). See the console.
AMUT.Grant.NoChoice: No choice made for "{text}"; add it by hand.
AMUT.Grant.NoVariant: No {table} result picked; add its items by hand.
AMUT.Grant.VariantMiss: {table} result "{label}" has no automation; apply it by hand.
AMUT.Grant.NoParts: {name} has no part list; add its items by hand.
AMUT.Grant.NotFound: Could not find the {type} "{name}" (is wfrp4e-core active?); add it by hand.
AMUT.Grant.SkillStub: Placeholder for {name} ({ref}), added by a mutation. Check its Characteristic against the book.
AMUT.Grant.SkillStubNote: {name} was not found in any compendium, so a placeholder skill was made ({ref}); check its Characteristic.
AMUT.Grant.NaturalArmour: Natural armour from {name}. Deleting that mutation removes this item.
AMUT.Grant.NoBump: No {name} trait to add Damage to; adjust by hand.
AMUT.Grant.PickVariant: No {table} result is recorded on this mutation. Roll it, or pick one:
AMUT.Grant.NoPool: {name} has no {pool} (only characters do); change it by hand if needed.
AMUT.Power.OracleActive: {name} is already active: end it with its End button first.
AMUT.Power.OracleFailed: {name}: the future stays hidden (Willpower Test failed).
AMUT.Power.OracleReason: {name}: sensing the future, +{n} Fortune for the scene
AMUT.Power.LunacyAsk: What is Morrslieb's state? (Daytime: no effect.)
AMUT.Power.LunacyFullEnds: Lunacy: Morrslieb no longer full, unspent Fortune removed
AMUT.Power.ReachPenalty: Elongated Limbs: -10 Penalty to {attacker} for having the shorter weapon ({defender}'s long arms).
AMUT.Power.ReachEven: Elongated Limbs: {attacker}'s long arms make the weapons the same length, no shorter-weapon penalty (cancels the -10 below).
AMUT.Warn.NoPermission: You lack permission to do that: only a GM can use this button.
AMUT.Warn.NoPermissionAdd: You lack permission to add mutations to {name}.
AMUT.Warn.NoGMCard: The mutation was added, but no GM is logged in to mark this card as resolved.
